messages:
alex: quick sync — we need to lock down audit export shape + quota semantics. product/legal/infra, can we align?

maria: @alex quick summary of constraints: product wants 'who changed what when' + per-change context in exports, console needs progress + cost preview. also want sampling option for very large tenants.

kevin: legal: must include immutable actor id and a "justification" field for sensitive changes. also thinking about redaction defaults for PII.

jordan: infra: major concern = spike/backpressure. we should avoid synchronous huge dumps. prefer two-mode approach: streaming NDJSON for live consumers, bulk S3 gz for large historical exports with signed URLs + resumable checkpoints.

alex: proposed semantics:
- Export types: streaming (SSE/HTTP chunked) or bulk (S3 gz NDJSON)
- Quotas charged in events (uncompressed) and also enforce per-tenant concurrent export jobs
- Events should include before/after diffs when available, and an actor reference (id + display)

maria: UX asks: show estimated event count + size + estimated cost before kick-off; run export as background job with live progress & failure reasons; allow resume on transient failures.

jordan: implementation note: use checkpoint tokens (opaque cursor per-tenant) so bulk jobs can resume. retention for checkpoint tokens = 48h by default. bulk jobs write to tenant-owned S3 or our temp bucket with signed urls.

srebot: infra note: export-worker autoscaling will handle throughput but we need global concurrency guard to avoid cluster OOM during giant tenant exports.

tom: security question: what PII do we include in exports? propose three redaction modes: `redact_all`, `redact_derived` (identifiers only), `none`. default should be conservative.

kevin: legal prefers `redact_derived` default. `none` must require explicit opt-in and a signed DPA addendum; audits need record of who enabled it and reason.

alex: sample NDJSON event we were discussing (minimal):
```json
{"event_id":"evt_01","ts":"2025-11-02T14:12:00Z","actor":{"id":"acct_123","type":"user","display":"jane.doe"},"change":{"path":"routing.policy:123","before":{"rules":[{"id":"r1","match":"*"}]},"after":{"rules":[{"id":"r1","match":"/v2/*"}]}},"justification":"updated canary policy for perf test"}
```

maria: console mock notes: show export job card with preview rows (first N events), cost estimate line, redaction mode dropdown, and a toggle for "include full actor emails (requires DPA)" grayed out unless legal flag set.

jordan: quotas proposal:
- free-tier: 500k events/day
- paid: 10M events/day
- dedicated/reserved: configurable per-contract
- rate limiting: events/sec per-tenant + throttling headers + exponential backoff guidance

alex: question for product/legal: do we include actor email in exports or keep only id/display? my leaning = id+display only.

kevin: keep id+display. email = PII; include only on explicit request with signed addendum and audit trail of approval.

maria: action items: alex -> draft API spec (shape + enums for redaction modes + cursor semantics). jordan -> prototype checkpoint/resume and S3 signed-url flow. kevin -> draft legal wording & DPA addendum. i'll add console mocks and cost calc.

alex: noted. I'll open PR with spec draft by EOD Thu.

export-bot: background: export job 2250001200 started for tenant:acme-corp mode:bulk-s3 events_est:2100000

maria: :raised_hands: thanks everyone, let's try to keep follow-ups in this thread and link mocks in the PR.
